summary: On August 28, 2026, Helix Energy Solutions Group, Inc. acquired Legacy Hornbeck Offshore Services, Inc. via a two-step merger. Helix converted from Minnesota to Delaware, then its subsidiaries merged with and into Legacy Hornbeck, which ultimately became a wholly owned subsidiary of renamed Hornbeck Offshore Services, Inc. Terms such as price per share, premium, and consideration were not disclosed in this excerpt. Shareholders approved at an August 31 special meeting; the acquirer's stock now trades as HOS. Watch for integration details and potential value realization from the combined offshore vessel operations.
